summary: Bitzero Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a land reservation agreement for ~33 hectares in Finland for potential HPC and data center development. The reservation is for six months, with initial 60MW capacity; terms of any definitive acquisition or lease are not yet disclosed. This is a standard business development update, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are provided. The release also notes an investor relations engagement with Think Ink for $246,500. There is no merger, acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of operational progress.
